title: debug_replay replays on a UTC clock, not the bundle time_zone the lane uses: 4 of 4 cycles publish differently
claim: tools/replay/debug_replay.py runs tests/replay.py:run_fixture in its own process without setting HASTUB_TZ, so a bundle whose replay half records time_zone Europe/Stockholm is replayed on the stub's UTC clock; over the owner's window's first hour every one of 4 cycles publishes differently from the same seeded replay in the lane's environment (replay.child_env(time_zone)), on 93 entity fields including Heat Pump Action's state, heat_pump_on and power_kw, the DHW schedule and the predicted indoor temperature.
mechanism: tests/replay.py:replay_one runs each fixture in a child whose environment child_env(fixture time_zone) sets HASTUB_TZ, and the stub's homeassistant.util.dt reads HASTUB_TZ once at import. debug_replay.main and run_seeded call run_fixture in-process and never set it, so dt_util.now() is UTC: local-hour logic (comfort day/night hours, DHW windows, the recorded price walk's local day and its 13:00 tomorrow-prices rule) runs an hour off for a CET install, and the plan, the action and the published entities differ from what the install computed and from what the lane would replay.

evidence.contention_note: box at load1 ~200 (many seats); counts are contention-immune, wall 6825 s provisional

instrumented_symbol: tools/replay/debug_replay.py:run_seeded over tests/replay.py:run_fixture; published records read through tests/replay.py:sweep from the production entities (heatpump_optimizer sensor/climate platforms)

perturbation.change: --perturb fixed: the shipped arm run with HASTUB_TZ set to the replay half's time_zone (debug_replay's one-line fix: set it from the bundle before importing the stub, or replay in replay.child_env)
perturbation.observed_value: synthetic bundle (fixture time_zone Europe/Stockholm), --hours 4: 8 of 8 differing shipped, 0 under --perturb fixed

metric_definition: Replay cycles whose published records (instants in UTC, _ms attributes dropped) differ between debug_replay as shipped and the same replay under replay.child_env(time_zone).
phenomenon_property: Every replay driver replays a recording on the clock zone the recording names (the replay half's time_zone), as the lane does, so a D15 timeline replay reproduces the install's local-time behaviour.
seam_rule: grep -n 'run_fixture(' tools/replay/*.py tests/*.py dev/audit/harnesses/*.py  # every in-process caller of run_fixture outside replay_one's child_env

null_control.note: the shipped arm against itself: the replay is deterministic once the _ms wall-time attributes are dropped, so every difference is the zone

reproduction_steps: ... m5_zone.py --bundle B --hours 1            # 4 of 4 cycles differ, 93 fields
proposed_fix_scope: tools/replay/debug_replay.py: read the replay half's time_zone before the stub is imported and set HASTUB_TZ (or re-exec itself under replay.child_env), as tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py should too for its fixture; a gate check in debug_replay.gate_checks that dt_util.DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE equals the fixture's zone during run_seeded.
